fixes.client_close: NotFound is accepted only after a valid final server response and the client DrainComplete was sent; all other close errors still fail
fixes.final_format: The complete candidate passed clang-format 22.1.5 after wrapping one close-transport log statement; all native runtime acceptance was rerun
fixes.format: Changed C++ and Python files are formatted and checked with clang-format, ruff check and ruff format --check
fixes.linux_loader: Absolute dynamic-loader paths such as /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 are accepted as system runtime; the test fixture includes this exact path
fixes.linux_test: test_linux_dependency_audit_uses_ldd_without_otool executes the Linux branch with a real fake ldd script
fixes.ubuntu: BuildGameplay uses ldd and permits only the actual Linux runtime libraries; otool is required only on macOS
fixes.windows_test: The fake ldd is executed through the current Python interpreter, never as a native executable, so the same test works on Windows and Unix
